page.overview:
Who is Love's Labour's Lost Characters?

Love's Labour's Lost has 17 named characters.

King Ferdinand - The King of Navarre who agrees to study for three years. He ends up falling in love with the Princess of France. He is one of the main characters in Love's Labour's Lost.

Berowne - One of the lords who chooses to study with the King. He is in love with Rosaline.

Dumain - One of the lords who chooses to study with the King. He is in love with Katherine.
